title: Global degree data for a finite Galois extension of a DVR
statement: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with fraction field $K$ and residue field $k$. Let $L/K$ be a finite normal separable field extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], where normal means that every element's minimal polynomial over $K$ splits into linear factors over $L$. Put $G=\operatorname{Aut}_K(L)$ and let $B$ be the integral closure of $A$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The set $X$ of maximal ideals of $B$ is finite and nonempty, and $G$ acts transitively on $X$. For each $\mathfrak q\in X$, the localization $B_{\mathfrak q}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a discrete valuation ring and $A\to B_{\mathfrak q}$ is local. For uniformizers $\pi_A$ and $t_{\mathfrak q}$, write $\pi_A=u_{\mathfrak q}t_{\mathfrak q}^{e_{\mathfrak q}}$ with $u_{\mathfrak q}$ a unit, and put $f_{\mathfrak q}=[B/\mathfrak q:k]$, the vector-space degree [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Then $e_{\mathfrak q}$ and $f_{\mathfrak q}$ are finite positive integers independent of $\mathfrak q$. Writing their common values as $e,f$ and $g=|X|$, one has $[L:K]=g e f$.

proof.text: A DVR is a Noetherian integrally closed PID, hence a Dedekind domain. Apply Mathlib IsIntegralClosure.finite and IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain to obtain finite normalization and the Dedekind property of B. Install IsIntegralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension and integrality of B over A. The scalar tower A-K-L gives torsion-freeness over A, which restricts to B.

source.place: Tag 09E8, finite normalization and Dedekind property; specialized directly by Mathlib.

proof.text: Let p be the nonzero maximal ideal of A. Integrality contracts every maximal ideal of B to a maximal ideal of A, necessarily p. Conversely a prime lying over the maximal ideal p is maximal by integrality. Thus maximal ideals are exactly p.primesOver B. Mathlib IsDedekindDomain.primesOver_finite gives finiteness; lying over for the finite faithful extension gives nonemptiness.

source.place: Tag 09E8, maximal ideals and primes above the base maximal ideal.

proof.text: Every prime q over p is nonzero, by faithful scalar action and p nonzero. The Dedekind localization theorem makes B_q a DVR. Its maximal ideal contracts to q, which contracts to p. The local_hom_TFAE criterion therefore makes A to B_q a local homomorphism.

For any uniformizers pi_A and t_q, injectivity of A to B_q makes the image of pi_A nonzero. Apply eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible to write it as u times t_q^n. If n were zero its image would be a unit, and localness would make pi_A a unit, contradiction. The image of p is therefore exactly the nth power of the maximal ideal of B_q. Mathlib ramificationIdx_eq and length_quotient_pow_maximalIdeal identify n with the ideal ramification index. Mathlib inertiaDeg_pos gives positivity of the finite residue degree.

source.place: Tag 09E8 and Algebra Tag 00PD; quotient-length comparison for the uniformizer exponent.

proof.text: Install the restriction MulSemiringAction of Gal(L/K) on B and IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing. Mathlib isPretransitive_of_isGaloisGroup gives pretransitivity on p.primesOver B. This agrees with the action in the statement: both send q to its image under galRestrict.

Choose e = p.ramificationIdxIn B and f = p.inertiaDegIn B. Mathlib ramificationIdxIn_ne_zero and inertiaDegIn_ne_zero give positivity; ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx and inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg identify them with the index and residue degree at every prime over p.

source.place: Tag 09EB, common positive ramification indices and residue degrees.

proof.text: The torsion-free module B over the PID A is flat. Apply the closed Mathlib theorem Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn to the finite flat Galois extension A to B: g*(e*f) = Nat.card Gal(L/K). Mathlib IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank identifies the right side with [L:K]. Reassociate multiplication and reverse the equality. This is the fundamental identity already proved in Mathlib, so no norm-valuation lemma is required.

source.place: Tags 09E8 and 09EB, fundamental identity; direct application of the existing Mathlib finite-flat Galois formula.

The item statement matches 09E8/09EB and is unchanged and not weakened. Small cases work: Q(i)/Q over Z_(2), Z_(3) and Z_(5) all give 2=gef. The helper lem-exc-dvr-norm-valuation-sum is a true DVR special case of 02MJ: ord is the normalized valuation, and I tested it on Z_(2)[i] with y=1+i and y=2+i, on units and on inverses. It is strictly more general than the parent, holding for arbitrary y with no Galois hypothesis. It is not elementary, has no duplicate in the DAG (rg for 02MJ, 09E8, sum_ramification_inertia and norm/valuation statements) and is not a Mathlib one-liner, so unsplit is correct. I checked every step's hypotheses: 032L Noetherian+normal+separable, 09IG one-dimensional Noetherian, the radical node with I=m_A, Dedekind localization, conjugacy from the 0BRK leaf, and the elementary e/f transport by sigma. The tool_use lem-sc-integral-closure-dedekind-surjective-fibres is accepted as a generic Krull-Akizuki black box. Two repairable citation faults are fixed in fixes/: (B3/C1) the helper statement and item step 8 used the field-norm determinant without a node, and both now cite def-weil-endomorphism-determinant; (C4) item step 5 applied the unit-times-uniformizer-power node, which needs Noetherian, without citing where that comes from, and it now cites def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring and lem-weil-pbc-pid-noetherian-normal. proof_deps was recomputed. lean.statement: theorem dvr_galois_degree_data (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] (B : Type z) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra B L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsIntegralClosure B A L] : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B).Finite ∧ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B).Nonempty ∧ (∀ q : Ideal B, q.IsMaximal ↔ q ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B) ∧ MulAction.IsPretransitive (Gal(L / K)) {q : Ideal B // q ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B} ∧ (∀ q : {q : Ideal B // q ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B}, IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime q.1) ∧ IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.1))) ∧ (∀ πA : A, Irreducible πA → ∀ q : {q : Ideal B // q ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B}, ∀ tq : Localization.AtPrime q.1, Irreducible tq → ∃ e_q f_q : ℕ, 0 < e_q ∧ 0 < f_q ∧ ∃ u_q : (Localization.AtPrime q.1)ˣ, algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime q.1) πA = (u_q : Localization.AtPrime q.1) * tq ^ e_q ∧ e_q = Ideal.ramificationIdx q.1 A ∧ f_q = Ideal.inertiaDeg q.1 A) ∧ (∃ e f g : ℕ, 0 < e ∧ 0 < f ∧ g = ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B).ncard ∧ (∀ q : {q : Ideal B // q ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).primesOver B}, Ideal.ramificationIdx q.1 A = e ∧ Ideal.inertiaDeg q.1 A = f) ∧ Module.finrank K L = g * e * f)
